name: CRESSE 2027: Advances in the Analysis of Competition Policy and Regulation
edition: 21st International Conference on Competition and Regulation
organizer: CRESSE (Competition and Regulation European Summer School and Conference)
submission_requirements: Send paper submissions in PDF form by email to info@cresse.info; presenters must disclose conflicts of interest (acknowledgement footnote and at start of presentation); accepted presenters may be asked to discuss another paper
registration_fee: EUR 500 (non-School participants; includes one dinner guest); EUR 300 for speakers, discussants and postgraduate students not in full-time employment (fee page does not state the year; linked registration form is for 2027)
keynotes: Heski Bar-Isaac (Rotman, Univ. of Toronto) - Competition Policy lecture; Myrto Kalouptsidi (Harvard) - JJ Laffont lecture; Niamh Dunne (LSE) - Lawyers' lecture
journal: CRESSE Annual Special Issue with IJIO; publication opportunities also with JAE
